name: Omabot
author: Dorneles
description: AI Bot & Prompt Directory for Omarchy: Search, explore, and 1-click copy AI bot prompts from botdirectory.ai with category filtering.

schema.label: Show Label on Bar
schema.description: Display 'omabot' label next to the icon on the bar.

schema.label: Bar Icon Style
schema.description: Preset icon displayed on the status bar (Robot, Sparkles, Brain, Prompt, Bot, Chip, Terminal, Alien).

schema.label: Custom Bar Icon
schema.description: Custom Unicode/Nerd Font character to display on the bar.

schema.label: Default Category
schema.description: Initial category selected when opening the bot directory.

schema.label: Auto-sync Interval (Hours)
schema.description: Interval in hours to periodically refresh bot prompts in the background from botdirectory.ai.
